en: That's not what I'd expect. Talking to you, you seem cheerful and forthright. Are you saying that's all just a facade?
Maybe? I'm not sure I really even know that myself.
In that case, I'll try to cut my way through to the real you that's hidden underneath.
Oh please, ya kinda said that in a lewd way.
See, and that's why I said you can't tell someone's personality based on their blood type.
Look, there are almost seven billion people in the world. It doesn't make sense to think they all come in only four types.
If AB people are all potential prodigies with dual personalities who are withdrawn and... all that stuff... At any rate, it's useless.
I don't care about yer logic, Akiyama-san. How come ya won't believe it when I tell ya?
I give up.
You're nothing like that at all. Are you trying to tell me you're an introvert?
Hmm. I guess I'm really not, huh? I've kinda been thinkin' as much.
That's the problem with personality assessments. It's all in your head.
No it ain't! In my experience, people fit their types dead-on! And the same goes for me!
All right. I'll have to look further into my compatibility with type AB girls.
Ooh, ya sneak! I still dunno what blood type you are, Akiyama-san!
Even if you did, how would you know I was even telling the truth? You don't need to know.
Well, then I wasn't tellin' the truth either!
Hahaha. Oh really now?
Get real. You're so indecisive.
AB girls are indecisive!
Ya see? What I've been sayin' really <Italic>is</Italic> right!
Well, color me surprised.
Maybe get your blood re-tested? Maybe you aren't really type AB.
Huh? C'mon, don't say such terrifyin' things like that! What am I gonna do if they got it wrong?
Isn't that better than not knowing? You could be in real trouble if you ever get seriously hurt.
It'd be worse findin' out I wasn't really my parents' kid! My mom kinda got around a lot. I mean, what if I'm... Like, it's possible, huh?
That would be bad, yeah.
Man, I'm starvin'.
You're hungry? Want me to order you something?
Not exactly. I'm just cravin' fatty foods.
Fatty foods?
Like I'm hungry for somethin' fatty. I'm all about that fat!
Ahh. So that's what you meant.
You don't want anything?
Nothin' I can eat here, at any rate.
What specifically do you want to eat?
Kushikatsu! Kushikatsu sound great!
They sure do! Dang, now I want some too.
Ya like those too, Akiyama-san? I like chicken karaage, too! I could gorge myself on some a' that right now!
You like it that much?
Yep! I wanna eat it every day!
No way! And you're still not tired of it?
I just switch up the flavors. Maybe add ketchup or mayonnaise or add a tiny bit a' lemon or salt.
Just hearing this gives me heartburn.
How do you keep your figure? Do you work out?
Well, I'm always talkin' about somethin'. That must burn off quite a few calories!
Your lips sure are getting a workout at least.
That's why I'm always bushed after work and wanna eat somethin' fatty.
Guess that's making you meet your nutritional needs. You'd better not quit your job.
I'll be fine. I talk this much all the time!
Guess I shouldn't have worried.
Fatty foods will make you gain weight. Wouldn't it be better to eat something else?
I make sure to eat properly! Stuff like takoyaki and okonomiyaki.
Sounds good! This really is the city where folks eat until they drop. There's so much here that sounds delicious.
Ain't that the truth? There's nothin' wrong with me. Blame it on Osaka!
I bet you spend a ton on food. Eating like that everyday must get expensive, right?
Not for me! I'm a real foodie. I'm lookin' forward to bein' treated by you, Akiyama-san!
Whoa, how did we end up there?
What else do you want to eat?
Kushikatsu.
I get it. I'll treat you to some later.
Ahahaha! Hooray!
I wanna eat kushikatsu!
Yeah, I get it...
That's basically the same thing. You don't really think that's healthy food, do you?
Well, what're ya hungry for right now?
What am I hungry for? I'm not hungry at all.
Then that means ya oughta drink more liquor. Then you'll be hungry for somethin'! So come on, why don't ya order somethin'?
You sure are a persuasive one. Not that there's anything wrong with that.
Say, Akiyama-san, do ya like stand-up comedy?
I do. I catch a lot of it while watching late night TV.
I knew it!
You knew it?
Not particularly, no.
Huh, for real? Guess my expectations were way off.
What expectations?
Well, you're fun to talk to and you're a snappy conversationalist, so I figured ya had to be a fan of stand-up comedy.
That's some unusual reasoning right there.
Is it? Ain't comedy fans the kinda people who're good at talkin' and listenin' to folks?
Folks who aren't good at talkin' just ramble on without a point and interrupt the conversation whenever. They're the worst!
Fair enough. I guess good conversationalists structure their thoughts for timing and delivery, the way comedians do when telling jokes.
See, ya do get me!
How's that relevant? People who like stand-up can be bad at conversation, and plenty of good conversationalists never watch stand-up at all.
I'm not sayin' it's true for everyone. Why do ya gotta take things to such literal extremes?
How about you? I bet you like stand-up, right? Do you go to see live performances?
'Course! And I buy DVDs and stuff, too!
Wow, you're really into it. Why are you such a big fan?
Why? 'Cause it's funny.
All right. I suppose that's straightforward enough. Though it's not really a reason.
What other reason do I need? Is there somethin' wrong with watchin' something 'cause it's funny?
No, that's not wrong at all.
Besides, doesn't laughin' make ya feel good? Watchin' stand-up makes me happy. I think the comedians are really amazin'!
I feel the same with you. Talking to you always brings a smile to my face.
Ya mean it!? That's so sweet of you to say!
When you get down to it, comedians and hostesses are both trying to make people smile.
Yeah! I bet a comedian who worked the nightlife business would be an instant hit!
Hmm. Scouting a girl like that's not a bad idea.
Are you under a lot of stress? Maybe stand-up comedy helps you blow it off.
Nah, that ain't it. I mean, I'm usually laughin', so I don't let small things get to me.
You're the easygoing sort. Having a good sense of humor is part of what Osaka is about.
Yep. Folks who don't like stand-up don't even crack a smile and come off all cold and stuff.
Then I should make an effort to smile.
Is it? Ain't comedy fans the kinda people who are good at talkin' and listenin' to folks?
What do you find funny about it?
I mean, it varies based on the comedian. Osaka and Tokyo have different comedy styles, y'know?
If a person doesn't know why it's funny, they oughta shut their yap for a bit and just watch. Then they'll get it.
I guess seeing is believing. All right. I'll try to watch and listen carefully next time.
People who constantly ask for explanations on why a comedian's jokes are funny are the worst. You should watch out, Akiyama-san.
Thanks for the warning.
My big brother's comin' home for New Year's. I haven't seen him in forever, so I'm really lookin' forward to it!
You must be very close.
Maybe I'm a bit too close. When he moved away from home I was in tears, tryin' to hold him back so he wouldn't go.
I'm kind of jealous. I wish you would fawn over me like that, Honoka-chan.
Maybe I oughta burst into tears and try to hold ya back from leavin' too, Akiyama-san.
Yes please. I'd love to see you cry.
Uh, I wasn't actually gonna do it. C'mon, get real.
What? That's disappointing.
Crocodile tears, I wager? That's no good.
So what? What's important is that I care enough about ya to cry.
Saying that kind of kills the whole point.
To force me to get an extension?
Bingo! I'm gonna sob all over ya if you don't ask for an extension!
That puts me in something of a bind.
Guess you're still a kid. Why not grow up and let that brother of yours go?
Nah, I'm okay with bein' spoiled. I don't got any particular plans to be a grown-up lady. And I'm short, so I'm like the kid-sister hostess.
You're very self-aware. If that's intentional, then well done.
Though actually, I'm kinda scared about seein' my brother.
Scared? Why? Because it's been so long?
Well, uh... He's actually bringin' his girlfriend home with him.
What's wrong with that? Isn't it great that he's found someone?
Everything's wrong with it! She's my rival now! I've been freakin' out about what to do.
That isn't good. That must make you feel weird, not knowing how to act around her.
That's exactly it! I can't be rude 'cause it'll upset my brother, so I'll have to force myself to smile and act all cheerful.
You'll get used to it. It's not nice to say that sort of thing before you've even met her. She might be a nice person.
That's all well and good, but what am I gonna do if our personalities wind up clashin'?
Try to accept her. You're going to have to, sooner or later.
I guess I just gotta suck it up.
Hey, I'll just tell my other big brother he can't go gettin' a girlfriend of his own!
Oh, you've got two older brothers?
Why not bring a boyfriend of your own? That might make your brother jealous.
Ahahaha! Hey, good idea!
She's your future sister-in-law. You have to make nice with her.
No way! Not in a million years!
'Cause I can't be friends with the girl who'll steal my big brother from me!
Hey, Akiyama-san, do ya think there's some way I can get my brother and his girlfriend to break up?
Maybe you should let this whole thing go.
Someone's in a good mood. What's up?
I went shoppin' earlier today and managed to get my stuff for half off!
Nicely done. Was there some kind of trick to it?
I kept sayin' stuff like, "Man, I'd buy this if it costs only this much," or, "Hey, I'll buy this if ya throw in this other thing for free."
I see. You've got a good handle on human psychology. That makes you good at haggling.
Right? We Osaka girls are a sharp bunch!
I couldn't do that. If I think the list price is too high I don't buy it, or if the list price is reasonable, I do.
Ya can't do that! The list price is all lies! They could sell stuff for half price and still make a profit, so ya may as well haggle.
I don't know about selling it for half price...
Do you always haggle when you go shopping?
Just buyin' somethin' is no fun. You get a sense of accomplishment if ya haggle!
You must really enjoy it. I bet you get friendly with the staff at these stores too.
Nah, ya gotta do it the other way around.
The other way around?
Yeah. Ya gotta make nice with 'em before they give you better prices. So they'll think yer sweet and deserve a discount.
Yikes! Women aren't to be trifled with, I see.
Sounds exhausting. Do you always have to be so gung-ho about it?
Hm. I guess sometimes I am pretty dog-tired after I'm done shoppin'.
But when it's been that rough, I go and brag to my friends about it and that perks me right up!
Even a shopping trip can be turned into a tale of heroism, huh? Haha.
'Course it can. I'd be a sorry excuse for a Kansai gal if I didn't embellish my stories!
You're a haggler. If you got it for half off, it couldn't have been that expensive to begin with. That's not really a big deal.
What are ya talkin' about? Money's important! Ya can't let even a single yen go to waste!
That's true enough. It's better to haggle and get something than not haggle and get nothing.
Exactly! Sometimes I'll cave in early and get it a bit cheaper, but I'll wind up wishin' I had stuck to my guns a little more.
That's good. People with that mindset are more proactive about making money than most, making it much easier to save.
Really? Ya sure know how to convince a girl, Akiyama-san! Now I'm gonna haggle even more!
You know, maybe I should hire you for one of my clubs.
That's a bad trait. Honestly, it's not good to let money dictate your life. You should aim for a life where you can have freedom from money.
I wouldn't be strugglin' now if I could choose. Us little people are better off bein' thrifty and not pretendin' like we're rich celebrities.
No, I suppose not.
No one likes a cheapskate. If being cheap gives a poor impression, it's better to spend money to improve your image.
So you're sayin' it's okay to waste money?
Sure. It feels good to go big when spending money.
Hmm. Really?
